# TripCheck Japan

> TripCheck is a worldwide-beta trip builder and Google Maps itinerary planner. It turns an unordered list of places, an optional hotel and flight times into geographic day groups, map-based routes, transport choices and route-aware meal ideas. Curated country profiles supply local time zones, airports, meal windows, currencies and mobility defaults; unsupported countries use a neutral profile.

## Canonical pages

- English: https://tripcheck-japan-tokyo.syoki.chatgpt.site/
- Japanese: https://tripcheck-japan-tokyo.syoki.chatgpt.site/ja

## What the product builds and checks

- Geographic day groups from an unordered wishlist
- A real Google Maps view that switches between trip days
- An efficient visit order and planning timeline for every day
- Walking, public-transport and driving estimates with fastest and recommended separated
- Hotel-area recommendations based on the entered wishlist's total travel
- Hotel-aware routes that start and end at the recognised base
- First-day start and last-day deadline from supported major-airport inputs
- Airport processing, early-arrival and city-transfer planning buffers
- Geographic relationship and a shorter order for places resolved across Japan
- Official restaurant URL previews with site thumbnails when available
- Explicit-time gap checks using editable stay assumptions and planning travel estimates
- Cross-city travel and poor geographic grouping
- Hidden station walking and transfer overhead
- Queues and missing buffers around timed-entry reservations
- Daily stop density and traveler energy load
- Whether a calmer order can preserve confirmed tickets and must-do places

## Differentiation

TripCheck is not a destination-discovery chatbot. Deterministic code handles location order, feasibility, time and confidence. Google Maps is embedded as the shared visual surface for each day and remains the final source for directions.

## Current limitations

The public planner is free. Unknown place names are sent to Google Places only when needed to locate them and are not stored by TripCheck. The browser immediately clusters and orders resolved locations; live routes, opening information, hotel and food candidates, cited public evidence and a forecast-horizon Open-Meteo outlook enrich the usable core plan afterward. Weather is context only and never moves a stop. Hotel ranking is geographic, not an availability or commission ranking. The planner does not optimize flights, ferries, border crossings or multi-time-zone travel between countries. Planning estimates must not be treated as verified travel facts.
